findings.evidence: `grep -rn "IsStarOfType.isFiniteType" TauCeti/` → only Branch.lean:49 and Branch.lean:89. Star/Classification.lean:261 `theorem isFiniteType_starCartanMatrix_three_iff {a b c : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) : IsFiniteType (starCartanMatrix ![a, b, c]) ↔ a = 0 ∨ (a = 1 ∧ b = 1) ∨ (a = 1 ∧ b = 2 ∧ c ≤ 4)`, whose `rintro` branches (lines 266-273) supply exactly the four shapes.
findings.fix: Delete `IsStarOfType.isFiniteType` and the two doc claims about it (Branch.lean:49-50); any future site gets it in one line from `(isStarOfType_iff ℓ t).mp h` plus `ht.submatrix e.injective`. If it is kept, drop the "converse of the fork bound / each admissible shape occurs" wording and point to `TauCeti.isFiniteType_starCartanMatrix_three_iff`, which already states that.
findings.issue: `IsStarOfType.isFiniteType` has no consumer anywhere in the repo (grep for `IsStarOfType.isFiniteType` hits only its own definition and the module-doc line 49), and its body is one unfolding plus `IsFiniteType.submatrix` (FiniteType/Basic.lean:201). Its stated purpose — "the converse of the fork bound ... each of the four admissible shapes does occur" (lines 49-50, 86-88) — is already proved on `main` by the ← direction of `isFiniteType_starCartanMatrix_three_iff` (FiniteType/Star/Classification.lean:261-273), which discharges `![1,1,c]`, `![1,2,2]`, `![1,2,3]`, `![1,2,4]` (and the chain case) via `isFiniteType_starCartanMatrix_one_one` etc.

summary: The relabellings and the D/E identifications reuse the existing private embeddings and Mathlib's Cartan matrices correctly, and the round-1 `isStarOfType_iff` finding is withdrawn — the contest is right that `hasCartanType_iff` (DynkinType.lean:410) is the established idiom for an unexposed predicate. One unused wrapper remains whose advertised content is already a theorem on `main`.
